mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals labor market stress that triggers central bank policy support, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy, declining industrial production signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines in supply-constrained regimes, or average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs, causing immediate negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases and payroll declines signal severe labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as recession risks intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, positive real GDP growth signals strengthening economic activity that boosts corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 grows in early-cycle expansion, or average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained declines in industrial production indicate manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
